entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Implement support for OLTP exporter environment variable configuration #54385
  • Add --list-devices support for dotnet test #54378
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #54369

Closed

  • .NET SDK 10.0.300 build/restore performance regression vs 10.0.204 for .slnx solution #54344
  • All `dotnet` command takes ~4.4s on .NET 11 preview 4 (Windows) #54282
  • `Publish*` properties should affect `build` -- making those apps RID-specific #34309
  • [NETSDKE2E] With 6.0.413 SDK installed, component names display incorrectly when installing workload. #34082
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] There is no telemetry events "*/v2.1/track" in Telemetry.json file after building project. #54352
  • Templating dependency is not AOT friendly #53177
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] The implicit runtime (8.0/9.0/10.0) for NET 11 preview 4 should be May update(8.0.27/9.0.16/10.0.8) #54117
  • https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/13979 #54365
  • Documentation-only changes should not require BuildAnalysis checks #54148
  • mslearn's xrefmap.json file is missing a few types #54293
